Method of Attack: Blackmailware that collects user information including screenshots of active desktop, browser cookies, browser history, computer and geographic info; changes desktop background; creates ransom notes accusing victim of spreading child pornography; demands bitcoin ransom to avoid sending data to law enforcement.
Discoverer: Reddit user (initial report) and subsequent analyst who found and analyzed samples
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (samples end with .scr extension to masquerade as screensaver)
Attack Vector: Downloaded executable file from porn sites (e.g., Xvideos)
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin addresses used for ransom payments: 1NziehGLXiEP11f3Ei8WjCXyuTdFZVsL2j, 1CzrDKSSCSJQgWKPMNCUmk6XM3FJosa6JD, 1CKpj2r2qLPcK4BL1FpP1MsATCCntLvy5q, 18AfNuXM1XSyz5zTdm4S87N1HCgM8ni5pW, 12nkyXjwYrqjDWRnPg4HVhnpfjH84bmtdU, 1GVTebsPjvFPsRZbZfCMXY4HGobFtMQGAD, 1P8VNkE5eVxZeDZWDsSJRfD14A46sLr6C4, 1LoUuj2EkqSiP5U1ejw8KR56dfopgSJuw4
